items.title: Z1T: Sparse Transformer‑Like Models for Probabilistic Hardware
items.summary: Introducing Z1T, our first family of transformer-like models for sparse probabilistic chips like Z1, exhibiting over 100x energy efficiency gains vs GPUs, and featuring a corresponding scaling law.

items.title: Open App Bridge (OAB) – A decentralized document handoff for web apps
items.summary: An open, vendor-neutral protocol allowing modern web applications to transfer documents and state directly in the browser—without relay clouds or vendor lock-in.
